Method of Attack: Backdoor mechanism parsing user-supplied HTTP request.headers for specially formatted commands allowing remote attacker to input and execute arbitrary code on running servers
Impacted Systems: npm projects depending on mailparser and its nested dependencies
Attack Vector: Malicious npm packages distributed via npm registry
Nested dependency chain through mailparser -> http-fetch-cookies -> express-cookies -> getcookies
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of getcookies package with backdoor code
Nested dependency chain including http-fetch-cookies and express-cookies
Removed versions 2.2.3, 2.2.2, 2.2.1 of mailparser containing malicious dependency
